linked_prs.title: fix(eval): no need to check length of valid_dl when using streaming dataset
linked_prs.body:
Thanks for your contribution and we appreciate it a lot. The following instructions would make your pull request more healthy and more easily get feedback. If you do not understand some items, don't worry, just make the pull request and seek help from maintainers.

## Motivation

![image](https://github.com/InternLM/InternLM/assets/24990260/55ebdd32-dad6-4cab-aa53-e7b11a5f702b)

As shown in the figure above, when StreamingDataset is enabled, evaluator still tries to determine whether the dataset is empty by the dataset length. This is completely unnecessary, first of all, StreamingDataset does not have the len method, and secondly, StreamingDataset filters out empty datasets during the construction process.

## Modification

So I modified the judgment condition to not judge the length when StreamingDataset is enabled

linked_prs.title: fix(RotaryEmbedding): Fix the error that RotaryEmbedding is converted to a non-fp32 format during operation
linked_prs.body:
fix(RotaryEmbedding): Fix the error that RotaryEmbedding is converted to a non-fp32 format during operation
## Motivation

1. The previous implementation of RotaryEmbedding will cause inv_freq and scale to be converted to non-fp32 formats during the training process, because the previous implementation mounted these 'parameters' on the buffer.
2. Add two forward methods to be compatible with the forward process of llama2.

## Modification

1. Only treat inv_freq and scale as class attributes.
2. Add two forward methods.

issues.title: 模型自行进行多轮对话问题
issues.body:
### 描述该错误

您好，我们在调用internlm-chat-7b这个模型的时候，发现模型针对一些prompt，会自行进行多轮对话。我看到官方提供的对话实例是model.chat，这个在内部实现是用response.split("<eoa>")[0]来保证了只返回第一个回复。但是如果要使用这个模型进行后续的实验如RLHF等，在调用model.generate时会输出后面的多轮内容，相关token也会加入到计算中，这个是不可接受的。请问有什么方式来避免输出多轮对话的内容吗？
